records.prompt: Create ONE sprite-sheet asset containing exactly SIX square pixel-art head-and-shoulder portraits of the SAME PERSON through aging, in a strict 3 columns x 2 rows grid. Output landscape aspect ratio 3:2, ideally 1536x1024, each cell exactly one third width and one half height. No gutters, no separators, no captions, no labels, no text, no border. The six cells read left to right then top to bottom: age8, age16, age30, age55, age70, age85. The attached image is a STYLE AND IDENTITY REFERENCE sheet only; select only the identity specified below, ignore the other nine identities. Preserve identity-specific eyes/nose/mouth shapes across ages with appropriate aging, and especially preserve the named hairstyle. All six use the SAME medium warm tan skin family, no different skin tone by age, dark-brown pixel contour, simple muted slate crew-neck shirt, uniform light cool gray background, matching upper-front illumination. Faithful detailed classic pixel art with crisp square pixel clusters on a logical 256x256 grid for each cell, no smoothing, no photorealism. Head perfectly front-facing, straight upright, neutral closed mouth, eyes open looking directly forward, ears visible, no glasses/beard/accessories. IMPORTANT uniform modular landmarks per 256x256 cell: center x128, pupils at (102,116) and (154,116), eyebrow line y101, nose tip(128,145), mouth center(128,165), chin center(128,195), neck center x128, shoulders at bottom. Match these landmarks in every age; age via wrinkles/cheeks/hair instead of shifting features. No hair covering eyebrows or eyes. Hair at y10..95. Entire head inside its cell. Each cell must fill exactly the same framing and scale. Identity: FEMALE, source top row first column: chestnut hair in two low pigtails, rounded face. Keep TWO LOW PIGTAILS at ALL ages including elderly, silvering late.
